checked.title: Cache-safety contract: append-only request assembly with a cache-hit meter and a CI test that fails when a middleware breaks the prefix
checked.evidence: libs/bog-agents/bog_agents/graph.py:264 (langchain AnthropicPromptCachingMiddleware appended) and :1087-1090 (sweeper placed so cutoff indices and cache prefix stay aligned); tests/unit_tests/test_middleware_canonical_order.py:92-125 (order locked with cache rationale); tests/unit_tests/test_street_sweeper.py:72 (message count/order preserved); tests/unit_tests/test_bedrock_prompt_caching.py:87-212; libs/cli/bog_agents_cli/prompt_cache.py:1-60 (/compact and /clear cache-break note). checked.delta: A replay harness that runs the canonical middleware stack over a scripted 10-turn session against a recording fake model and asserts the serialized prefix is byte-identical turn over turn (covering sweeper, summarization, prompt caching, expert-rule and stop-gate injections); a declared stable-prefix/volatile-tail contract on injectors that touch the system message or follow-up HumanMessages; a cache-read ratio in the usage strip (shares UI with the per-message usage strip candidate).
checked.competitor: Goose v1.46.0 'cache-safe request assembly with append-only turn context and declared cache semantics'; OpenCode v1.17.9
checked.why_killer: Users pay 10x less for the 90% of each request that is unchanged, and bog's 100-middleware stack stops silently breaking caching every time someone injects a reminder; competitors with 5 middleware never had this risk, so a locked contract is a defensible answer to 'big stack = expensive'.

checked.delta: A `managed` layer at the top of the settings cascade sourced from a signed URL or repo path (fetched at start, cached, signature-verified) carrying allowed_mcp_servers, skill_allowlist (default deny), plugins_enabled, provider_lock (gateway-only base_url), zero_retention; enforced in mcp_tools.py discovery, the SkillsMiddleware dir filter, create_model, and plugin install; surfaced as org-pinned rows in /permissions and /doctor and recorded in Expert evidence packs.
